## Description

Baker's and brewer's yeast: diploid oval cells of ~5 × 6 µm that reproduce by budding. With oxygen it
respires; without it, it ferments sugar to alcohol and CO₂. It lives on fruit and in the laboratory,
not in water drops.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An osmotroph with [budding](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md); not seeded in drops (it is inoculated).

## Not implemented yet

- No ethanol field and no Crabtree effect (it does not ferment in the presence of O₂ with excess
  glucose).
- No haploid/diploid cycle or mating.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares budding with *Candida* and *Euglypha*.
